name: Eastern Creek 1 (EC1)

address.note: Campus address; Lot 2 DP 1159804 per SSD-10330 SEARs request.

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services address point for 17 ROBERTS ROAD EASTERN CREEK. Address point, not building centroid; campus spans a larger lot.

builder.note: Original building constructed for HP (Aurora, 2011-12); head contractor not found.

developer.note: Original developer of the building housing EC1; site later owned by DXC Technology and acquired by CDC 14 Dec 2018 (source 1).

mw_it.note: 6 MW per CDC Oct 2019 deck; DCD Dec 2022 gives 7 MW (source 7).

cost_aud_m.note: HP reported initial A$119m build, ~A$200m spent on whole Aurora site by 2012 (source 4); not specific to EC1.

authority.note: Project approval 10_0142 granted by 'The then Minister for Planning' on 7 December 2010 for 'Construction and operation of data storage facility, comprising two data storage cells and associated infrastructure' (SSD-10330 Assessment Report, Table 1). Ongoing operation of this existing data centre remains under 10_0142.

pathway.note: Mod-2 Modification Report calls it 'the Part 3A approval, MP10_0142'.

reference.note: Covers the original ex-HP building with two data storage cells (inferred to be EC1 and EC2). CDC's later works to this building used complying development certificates, e.g. CDC-21-00315 'CDC 1 - Extension and internal alterations to class 5 part' (25 Feb 2021) and CDC-23-01195 'Construction of office space in EC1' (10 Aug 2023) (source 11).

determined.note: Per DPIE/DPHI Assessment Reports for SSD-10330 and Mod-1; the Mod-2 Modification Report (Urbis) says 7 December 2012, which is taken to be an error (the building opened 2011-12). NSW portal page for MP10_0142 not found.

jobs_construction.note: No figures for the original ex-HP building. The SSD-10330 jobs figures (448 construction, 10 operational) apply only to Buildings 4-6. CDC (ARN, Dec 2022): campus construction since 2018 'has created hundreds of jobs'.

construction_end.note: EC1 is inferred to be one of the two pre-existing ex-HP/DXC data halls (source 2); HP Aurora first services 1 Dec 2011, formal opening June 2012 (source 3). SSD-10330 Assessment Report: the existing data centre 'has been in operation since 2012' (source 10).

open_questions: scope: excluded - pre-2018-09-01 completion (ex-HP 'Aurora' hall, MP10_0142, operational from 2011-12); removed from master.csv and listed in excluded.csv (decision 2026-09-27)
which of the two ex-HP data storage cells is EC1 vs EC2 is not stated in the planning documents
builder of the original HP building not found
